tool_input.body:
## Summary

Mission-close state for cluster 3 (`m-2026-09-10-001`), written by `ethos mission result` and `ethos mission close` after PR #515 merged as `6f61406`.

Contents:
- `results.yaml` — the round-1 result artifact (verdict `pass`), with declared `files_changed` counts taken from the real `git diff --numstat` rather than written by hand
- updated `contract.yaml` and the delegation record
- the sealed session log and audit chunks

## Why

These are the delegation audit trail and are tracked deliberately, per the two-zone split in DES-058: sealed chunks are git-tracked under `.punt-labs/ethos/`, while the live tail stays gitignored under `.punt-labs/local/`. The mission-close operation necessarily writes them after the work PR has already merged, so they cannot ride in that PR and need this follow-up.

The result artifact records three residuals rather than leaving them implicit:
- a `setsid`-detached hook child escapes process-group cleanup — no portable, unprivileged containment exists across shipped targets
- no Windows CI job, filed as `ethos-ell5` (P1)
- `tests/behavioral` and `internal/repomiss` report 0.0% coverage, filed as `ethos-21v0` (P2)

## Verification

docs-only — Phase 3 verification N/A. No runnable code touched; the diff is mission state plus sealed audit chunks.
